rationale.intuition: 弱 profile 在 Harvard RD。GPA 3.2 / SAT 1250 远低于 admit pool 25th percentile。但引擎仍应给 >0% (Harvard 偶尔录非传统强势申请者) 且 ≤5%。Anchor × 0.1 floor 防止 0%，profile 显著 below admit pool 拉低。

sources.name: Harvard CDS 2024-25
sources.evidence: SAT 25th percentile 1500; GPA 25th percentile ~3.85. Applicant well below both — but Harvard still admits non-traditional <2% of below-25th applicants per published interview data

sources.name: Counselor Engine Floor
sources.evidence: anchor × 0.1 floor = 0.365%; engine should land somewhere between floor and ~5% reflecting genuine but very low probability
